SELECT c.comment_id, c.blog_id, b.title AS blog_title, c.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.email, c.content, c.like_count, c.ip_address, c.status, c.is_pinned, c.created_at FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN blogs b ON c.blog_id = b.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_comments, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 0) AS pending_review, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 1) AS approved, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 2) AS rejected, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE) AS today_comments, COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) AS total_likes FROM comments WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' * #{days}
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM comments WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' * #{days} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT blog_id AS "blogId", 'Blog #' || blog_id AS "blogTitle", COUNT(*) AS "commentCount" FROM comments WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' * #{days} GROUP BY blog_id ORDER BY "commentCount" DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.user_id AS "userId", u.username, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS "commentCount", COALESCE(SUM(c.like_count), 0) AS "likeCount" FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' * #{days} GROUP BY c.user_id, u.username ORDER BY "commentCount" DESC, "likeCount" DESC LIMIT #{limit}
